clips.title: The story
paras: Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm is an overrun homestead in northern Westfall, just off the main road from Elwynn Forest. Once a prosperous plot tended by Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna, the fields and farmhouse have been seized by the Defias Brotherhood and prowling harvest golems.

Situated near the northern border of Westfall, Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm was once known for producing robust crops to feed the kingdom. That ended when the Defias Brotherhood swept across the countryside. Outlaws drove Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna from their land, leaving their fields overrun with mechanical harvest golems programmed to attack anyone approaching. With the farm buildings occupied by bandits and the fields prowled by renegade machinery, the rightful owners have been forced to camp along the roadside near the Jansen Stead, mourning the loss of their home and livelihood.

The farm's fall illustrates the broader collapse of law and order across Westfall. With Stormwind's military garrison spread thin and unable to safeguard rural freeholders, the Defias Brotherhood easily claimed homesteads like Furlbrow's. Bandits use the property as an staging ground and camp while letting lethal harvest watchers guard the perimeter, leaving travelers on the nearby highway vulnerable to ambush.
